findings.expected_vs_actual: Accuracy note, not a defect: the turn-fold fix says to call whenever your chance is at least the price. Under the rules a hand well ahead of the calling-a-raise range is told to raise, and a draw may call a little below the price (implied odds). The justification covers implied odds; the fix leaves both out for brevity. The wording is user-approved (Q-1).
findings.fix: None required; optional future copy polish.

summary: All 7 SPEC items PASS. The suite (1572 passed), lint and typecheck are green; integrity is clean; only the 7 approved text fields changed in the data, and the docs match row by row. The new fix sentences render on the Session Report and ship in the production bundle. All seven texts are accurate against the pot-odds-call (with the turn river bet), implied-odds-call, value-raise (>65%) and check-free rules. No blocking findings.
